question: How are the śakti and kīla syllables placed in the tenth nyāsa?
premises: The syllable hrīṃ as śakti is placed on the two feet
The syllable āṃ as kīla is placed in the navel
This procedure is the tenth nyāsa
inference: The tenth nyāsa places hrīṃ as śakti on the feet and āṃ as kīla in the navel.
plain_english: Place hrīṃ as the śakti on the two feet and āṃ as the kīla in the navel; this is the tenth.
